name: tests-quarter-gonum-stable-log-tail-and-interval-probabilities
instr:
Add logarithmic tails, closed-interval probabilities and batch queries in gonum.org/v1/gonum/stat/distuv. Preserve existing behaviour.

Normal, Gamma, Beta, StudentsT, Uniform, Pareto, Weibull, Laplace, LogNormal, Poisson and Binomial expose LogCDF and LogSurvival. Their exponentiated moderate results agree with CDF and Survival; NaN queries return NaN. Beta and Binomial return exact logarithmic support endpoints; Gamma and LogNormal return -Inf/0 at nonpositive queries, Pareto at/below Xm, and Weibull below zero. Uniform tails agree with its existing boundary probabilities. Poisson LogCDF floors nonintegral queries.

Normal and StudentsT reflected arguments exchange cumulative/survival logarithms; Laplace does so around Mu. Keep finite extreme Normal tails, Gamma upper tails, Beta boundary tails, LogNormal and Weibull upper tails, and rare Poisson/Binomial upper tails. Pareto.LogSurvival(x) agrees with -Alpha*log(x/Xm) at large x.

IntervalProb returns closed-bound mass, including Poisson/Binomial singleton point mass and zero for lattice gaps. Support-spanning Uniform/Beta/Pareto/Gamma intervals return one. IntervalLogProb returns -Inf for empty Uniform/support-gap mass and finite negative extreme Normal interval mass. Its exponential agrees with representable Gamma/Poisson/LogNormal interval probabilities. Moderate Normal interval mass agrees with CDF subtraction. Either NaN bound returns NaN; reversed bounds panic.

Batches return scalar results in query order, preserve N
